name: 书剑天下 (ShuJian MUD)
group_note: ShuJian MUD family base. Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- this lib's own NOTES.md documents a full native-driver deep functional test (2026-07-24) that played through registration, movement, character info, combat (the muren training-dummy safe-sparring mechanism), and menpai/skill systems as an ordinary new player, finding and fixing one real bug along the way (cmds/usr/top.lpc's add_rank() family: an unbounded per-hour rank-decay loop that blew the eval-cost limit on every single quit/top command once the archive's genuine 2008-era shipped rank data was booted against a modern wall clock -- capped at 240 iterations). Only shop/economy and death/respawn were flagged as not conclusively live-tested (a live-run gap, not a known-broken caveat). The lib's own README documents no caveat and none was found. This pass re-verified the pre-seeded admin account's login under the current WASM driver build (fluffos/Mud@2026, 'look'/'score'/'quit' all clean, '您目前的权限是：(admin)') -- fresh registration was not re-run this pass since NOTES.md's 2026-07-24 deep test already covers it end-to-end; a sibling in the same codebase family (bxsj1) had its full registration flow (id -> confirm -> password x2 -> Chinese name -> talent roll -> email -> gender) re-verified fresh this pass with identical results.
